name: nc/icon
title: Icon
description: Inline SVG icon: a site icon, or one of the built-in icons. A site icon with the name of a built-in icon replaces it.
aiHints: Without a label the icon is decorative. With a label it becomes an image with an accessible name. Site icons come from nucleo-icons-set, or from the CLI: nucleo icons import <folder of SVG files>, nucleo icons add mdi:car lucide:truck (any Iconify library, downloaded once and stored on the site). Use the icons of the design: when the design has its own set, import it instead of using the built-in icons. Color follows the color style of the block.
